coreMemory.chinese: 死亡；去世；消失；停止运转
coreMemory.english: v. to stop living；v. to stop existing, operating, or being noticeable
coreMemory.structure: die of an illness /ˈdaɪ ˈʌv ˈæn ˈɪlnəs/（死于疾病）；die from an injury /ˈdaɪ ˈfrʌm ˈæn ˈɪndʒɚi/（因受伤而死亡）；die in an accident /ˈdaɪ ɪn ˈæn ˈæksədənt/（在事故中丧生）；die at an age /ˈdaɪ ˈæt ˈæn ˈeɪdʒ/（在某个年龄去世）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ die by cancer → ✅ die of cancer；❌ His grandfather is died → ✅ His grandfather is dead / has died

commonErrors.note: 死于疾病或内部原因通常用 die of；外部原因常用 die from

commonErrors.right: His grandfather is dead / has died
commonErrors.note: dead 是状态形容词；die 是不及物动词，不用 be died

coreMemory.directSynonym: pass away /ˈpæs əˈweɪ/（去世）；perish /ˈpɛrɪʃ/（死亡；毁灭）；expire /ɪkˈspaɪr/（死亡；期满）；succumb /səˈkʌm/（不敌而死）；cease functioning /ˈsiːs ˈfʌŋkʃənɪŋ/（停止运转）
coreMemory.directAntonym: survive /sɚˈvaɪv/（幸存；活下来）；be born /ˈbiː ˈbɔːrn/（出生）；start up /ˈstɑrt ˈʌp/（启动；开始运转）
coreMemory.example: Many people still die of preventable diseases.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 仍有许多人死于可预防的疾病。

meanings.translation: 这位诗人于一九八四年去世。

meanings.english: to stop existing, operating, or being noticeable

items.phrase: a custom that is dying out
the leaves die back each year

fixedPhrases.example: Thousands still die of malaria each year.
fixedPhrases.translation: 每年仍有数千人死于疟疾。

fixedPhrases.example: The animal died from injuries sustained in the fire.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这只动物因火灾中受的伤死亡。

fixedPhrases.example: Three workers died in the mining accident.
fixedPhrases.translation: 三名工人在矿难中丧生。

fixedPhrases.example: The composer died at the age of eighty-two.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这位作曲家八十二岁去世。

fixedPhrases.example: She died peacefully with her family beside her.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她在家人陪伴下安详去世。

fixedPhrases.example: Several local traditions are in danger of dying out.
fixedPhrases.translation: 几项当地传统正面临消失的危险。

fixedPhrases.example: The wind died down shortly after sunset.
fixedPhrases.translation: 日落后不久风渐渐停了。

fixedPhrases.example: Their footsteps died away in the corridor.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们的脚步声渐渐消失在走廊里。

fixedPhrases.example: The stems die back each winter and return in spring.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这些茎每年冬天枯萎，春天再长出。

fixedPhrases.example: I am dying to hear how the interview went.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我非常想知道面试进行得怎样。

fixedPhrases.example: The proposal died a natural death when funding ended.
fixedPhrases.translation: 资金中断后，这项提案自然不了了之。

fixedPhrases.example: Even when the score was 0–2, the team refused to say die.
fixedPhrases.translation: 即使比分是零比二，球队也不肯言弃。

synonyms.difference: 委婉说法，通常用于人；人或动物死亡与机器失效所用主语和语体不同
正式，常指事故、灾难或严酷条件中死亡；人或动物死亡与机器失效所用主语和语体不同
表示死亡时正式或旧式；人或动物死亡与机器失效所用主语和语体不同
常与 to illness/injuries 连用
只对应机器、电池等失效义；人或动物死亡与机器失效所用主语和语体不同

antonyms.usage: 与死亡相反，尤其指经历危险或疾病后仍活着
be born 标志生命开始，die 标志生命结束；二者只在生命周期起点和终点这一范围内构成对立。
a machine dies 表示它停止运转，it starts up 表示设备从停机状态进入运行状态。

derivatives.note: die 的核心名词，常与 cause/of/from 连用
描述无生命或设备无电、无信号
指可以导致死亡的物质、疾病或威胁
只在 deathly pale/quiet/afraid 等有限搭配中常见

confusables.difference: die 和 dye 同音，但 die 表示死亡，dye 表示给物品染色
die /daɪ/ 与 dine /daɪn/ 拼写只差 n；die 表示死亡，dine 是较正式的进餐动词。

coreMemory.english: v. to obtain something by paying money；v. to accept or believe an idea or explanation
coreMemory.structure: buy something /ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（购买某物）；buy something for someone /ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmˌwʌn/（给某人买某物）；buy someone something /ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（给某人买某物）；buy something from someone /ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfrʌm ˈsʌmˌwʌn/（从某人处购买某物）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ buy it by ten dollars → ✅ buy it for ten dollars；❌ buy something to someone → ✅ buy something for someone / buy someone something

commonErrors.note: 表示购买价格用 for + 金额，不用 by

commonErrors.right: buy something for someone / buy someone something
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈfɔːr ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈbaɪ ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
commonErrors.note: buy 的双宾语结构用 for，不用 to

coreMemory.directSynonym: purchase /ˈpɝːtʃəs/（购买）；acquire /əˈkwaɪɚ/（购得；获得）；obtain /əbˈteɪn/（获得）；procure /proʊˈkjʊr/（采购；设法获得）；invest in /ˌɪnˈvɛst ɪn/（投资购买）
coreMemory.directAntonym: sell /ˈsɛl/（出售）；give away /ˈɡɪv əˈweɪ/（送掉；赠送）；return /rɪˈtɝːn/（退回；退货）

meanings.english: to obtain something by paying money
to accept or believe an idea or explanation
meanings.example: I do not buy his excuse.

items.chinese: 买下一家较小的竞争对手

fixedPhrases.example: We bought a new refrigerator last week.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们上周买了一台新冰箱。

fixedPhrases.example: She bought a warm coat for her father.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她给父亲买了一件暖和的外套。

fixedPhrases.example: I bought my niece a picture book.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我给侄女买了一本图画书。

fixedPhrases.example: The cafe buys its bread from a local bakery.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这家咖啡馆从当地面包店进面包。

fixedPhrases.example: He bought the replacement part online.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他在网上买了替换零件。

fixedPhrases.example: They bought the land at a reasonable price.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们以合理价格买下了土地。

fixedPhrases.example: Restaurants often buy rice in bulk.
fixedPhrases.translation: 餐馆经常批量购买大米。

fixedPhrases.example: Avoid buying furniture on credit if the interest is high.
fixedPhrases.translation: 如果利息高，应避免贷款买家具。

fixedPhrases.example: The staff did not immediately buy into the new strategy.
fixedPhrases.translation: 员工没有立即接受这项新策略。

fixedPhrases.example: The temporary repair bought us time to order a new pump.
fixedPhrases.translation: 临时维修为我们争取了订购新水泵的时间。

fixedPhrases.example: Money cannot buy genuine friendship.
fixedPhrases.translation: 金钱买不到真挚的友谊。

fixedPhrases.phrase: the best that money can buy
fixedPhrases.chinese: 金钱能买到的最好的东西
fixedPhrases.example: The clinic uses the best equipment that money can buy.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这家诊所使用能买到的最好的设备。

synonyms.difference: 较正式，常用于商业或书面语；付钱购买、设法取得和相信说法并非同一结构
强调取得所有权，方式不限；付钱购买、设法取得和相信说法并非同一结构
范围较广，不一定付钱；付钱购买、设法取得和相信说法并非同一结构
正式，强调为特定需要取得；付钱购买、设法取得和相信说法并非同一结构

antonyms.usage: 在交易双方行为上与购买相反；付钱购买、设法取得和相信说法并非同一结构
buy 通过付款获得物品所有权，give away 不收钱地把自己的物品转给别人。
buy an item 是完成购买并取得商品，return it 是将商品交回卖方以撤销交易。

derivatives.note: 可指消费者或企业中负责采购的人
指购买一家公司或买断某人的权益

confusables.difference: buy /baɪ/ 与 by /baɪ/ 同音；buy 是购买的动词，by 常作介词表示方式、位置或施事者。
buy /baɪ/ 与 bye /baɪ/ 同音；buy 是购买的动词，bye 用于告别，也可作名词表示轮空。

examples.chinese: 居民逐渐厌倦了持续不断的噪声。

examples.english: He grew in confidence with every presentation.
examples.chinese: 每做一次演示，他的信心就增强一些。

examples.english: Online sales grew by twelve percent last year.
examples.chinese: 去年线上销售额增长了百分之十二。

examples.english: The farm grows organic vegetables for local schools.
examples.chinese: 这家农场为当地学校种植有机蔬菜。

examples.english: We grew the tomatoes from seed.
examples.chinese: 这些番茄是我们从种子开始培育的。

examples.english: The unusual song grew on me after a few listens.
examples.chinese: 听了几遍后，我逐渐喜欢上了这首不同寻常的歌。

studyFocus.coreMeaning: 先掌握“生长；成长；发展”这个核心义，再对比另外 3 个常用义项，辨别不同语境。
studyFocus.keyCollocation: 把“grow quickly”连同介词、宾语和动词形式作为整个句块记忆。
studyFocus.commonMistake: grow 构成现在进行时时要用 growing，不能把动词原形直接放在 are 后
studyFocus.mustUseExample: The small company continues to grow quickly.（这家小公司继续快速发展。）
